system.description: When you deal [Unarmed Damage] or [Weapon Damage] to a creature on the same turn which you moved at least 10 or more feet, prior to the damage roll, you can force them to make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, they are Shaken and thrown 30 feet into a direction of your choice. If they are thrown upward, you can cast a jutsu with the Finisher keyword, as if you cast a jutsu with the Combo keyword.
